messages:
amelia: Merged PR #2185 that adds `pii_log_toggle` and `audit_mode` flags. Default: off. Need ops handover + canary plan for enabling PII logging for support traces. @ryan @priyanka FYI.

ryan: Thanks — can you paste the rollout steps? We'll need a canary: staging -> prod, 2% -> 10% -> 100%.

amelia: Steps in PR comment — copied:
```
# feature flags
pii_log.enabled=false
pii_log.canary_percent=0.02
pii_log.kms_path=customer-kms-primary
pii_log.hsm_fallback=true
pii_log.retention_days=90
```
Will put into ops-runbook.

priyanka: Heads-up from compliance: 90 days is ok but legal asked for export controls — audit_mode=true only for EU regions. Need region gating.

kai: Ops notes: deploy-bot will handle canary toggles. Use:
`./bin/flagctl set pii_log.enabled true --percent 2 --region us-east1`
Rollback: `./bin/flagctl set pii_log.enabled false`

deploy-bot: AUTO: Canary toggle started by ryan at 1765433900, target=2%, region=us-east1. Monitor: #incidents and /dash/pii-log-rate.

ryan: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary at 10:30 UTC. Will attach perf metrics and error budget links.

priyanka: Added a quick checklist: 1) KMS keys verified 2) HSM failover tested with simulated decrypt failure 3) Alert if pii-rate > 0.5% of requests 4) Legal sign-off in doc: https://docs.redwood/sec/pii-rollout

amelia: Thanks. I scheduled a 15min handover at 10:00 UTC to walk through runbook. If canary looks good, promote to 10% then 100% across us-east1 and eu-west1. If any error spikes revert immediately. cc @morgan (support) to watch ticket routing.

morgan: On standby. Will create support runbook snippet.
